about: Film v4, the infomercial cut: one narrator explains, whole takes only (no cuts inside a sentence). Replies quoted on screen are word for word from the Household Orders runs in video/tapes; numbers from the same runs and from PR #27's CI.

lines.text: This is Hearsay: preflight checks for voice add-ons. You write what your customers say. Hearsay plays it against your server, clean and misheard, and fails the build when it would go wrong out loud.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, introducing the product with pride. Fast, crisp and precise, a smile in the voice, clear emphasis on 'Hearsay'. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: In a chat window, add-ons look fine. Out loud, they break: a number heard wrong, a reply that reads out JSON, a list too long to remember, a no that still places the order.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, explaining a problem with a light touch, a short beat between the four examples. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Here's how. When someone speaks, only one step is your code: the server.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, revealing a clever trick. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Hearsay plays the rest, straight from your test case: the words, the mishearings, and the tool call the model would make. Then it checks what your server answers.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, explaining how it works. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: No microphone. No model. No API keys. The same result every time, so it runs on every pull request.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, listing benefits with punch. Fast, crisp and precise, short beats between the first three. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Every answer is graded by the rules Amazon published for add-ons: half a second per tool, short replies, no JSON, five options at most, and no payment without naming what and how much.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, running through a checklist. Fast, crisp and precise, a light beat between the items. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Here's a real run, on a grocery add-on. One take, no cuts.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, starting a live demo. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Fifty instead of fifteen, taken without reading it back. A no that placed the order anyway. Twenty errors. Exit one. The build fails.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, calling out results of a live demo. Fast, crisp and precise, punchy on the numbers. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: The fixed build, same tests.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, showing the after shot. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: The misheard fifty is refused, and the add-on says why.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, explaining, pleased. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Zero errors.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, satisfied, a small smile. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: And it guards every pull request. This change let fifty dollars of fruit skip the budget.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, explaining a real example. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Hearsay caught it, and the check went red.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, a satisfied, matter-of-fact beat. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: One fix, and it's green.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, a light, happy payoff. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: But wait, there's more. Hearsay is also an MCP server. Your coding agent runs it, fixes what it finds, and runs it again, until it's green.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, with a playful wink on 'But wait, there's more', then explaining. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: And it can't cheat: change a locked test,
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, a confident aside, the sentence continues after a pause. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: and the run fails.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, finishing the sentence with a wink. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: We measured it with coding agents. A suite alone made them stop at green, so Hearsay now shows what your suite doesn't cover. The result: zero defects left behind, and better on the rules nobody told them about.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, presenting honest results. Fast, crisp and precise, credible rather than salesy. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: And the price? Zero. Hearsay is open source. No keys, no account. Clone it, install it, run it.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, the classic price reveal with a grin, then quick and practical. Fast, crisp and precise. Never shouty, never cheesy.

lines.text: Hearsay. Hear it before your customers do.
lines.direction: Upbeat, charismatic host of a modern tech infomercial, the closing tagline, warm and confident, a small pause after 'Hearsay'. Never shouty, never cheesy.
